# Crossplane XRD + Composition: Versioned Bucket, RDS, IAM Role

## Project Structure

```
crossplane-infra/
├── apis/
│   ├── xrd.yaml                    # Composite Resource Definition
│   └── composition.yaml            # Composition (function-patch-and-transform)
├── functions/
│   └── function-patch-and-transform.yaml
├── providers/
│   ├── provider-aws-s3.yaml
│   ├── provider-aws-rds.yaml
│   ├── provider-aws-iam.yaml
│   └── provider-configs/
│       ├── dev.yaml
│       └── prod.yaml
├── claims/
│   ├── dev/
│   │   └── app-infra.yaml
│   └── prod/
│       └── app-infra.yaml
└── secrets/
    ├── dev/
    │   └── db-credentials.sops.yaml
    └── prod/
        └── db-credentials.sops.yaml
```

---

## 1. Composite Resource Definition (XRD)

```yaml
# apis/xrd.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xappinfras.infra.example.com
spec:
  group: infra.example.com
  names:
    kind: XAppInfra
    plural: xappinfras
  claimNames:
    kind: AppInfra
    plural: appinfras
  connectionSecretKeys:
    - db-connection-string
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              required:
                - environment
                - region
              properties:
                environment:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    - dev
                    - prod
                  description: Deployment environment
                region:
                  type: string
                  description: AWS region
                bucketName:
                  type: string
                  description: S3 bucket name (must be globally unique)
                dbInstanceClass:
                  type: string
                  description: RDS instance class
                  default: db.t3.micro
                dbMultiAZ:
                  type: boolean
                  description: Enable Multi-AZ for RDS
                  default: false
                dbAllocatedStorage:
                  type: integer
                  description: RDS allocated storage in GB
                  default: 20
                enableReplication:
                  type: boolean
                  description: Enable cross-region S3 replication
                  default: false
                replicationRegion:
                  type: string
                  description: Target region for S3 replication
                oidcProviderArn:
                  type: string
                  description: EKS OIDC provider ARN for IRSA
                oidcProviderUrl:
                  type: string
                  description: EKS OIDC provider URL (without https://)
                serviceAccountNamespace:
                  type: string
                  description: K8s namespace of the service account
                serviceAccountName:
                  type: string
                  description: K8s service account name
                deletionPolicy:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    - Delete
                    - Orphan
                  default: Orphan
              # Conditional requirements enforced via CEL
              x-kubernetes-validations:
                - rule: "self.environment != 'prod' || self.dbMultiAZ == true"
                  message: "prod environment requires Multi-AZ RDS"
                - rule: "self.environment != 'prod' || self.enableReplication == true"
                  message: "prod environment requires S3 cross-region replication"
                - rule: "self.environment != 'prod' || has(self.oidcProviderArn)"
                  message: "prod environment requires OIDC provider for IRSA"
            status:
              type: object
              properties:
                bucketArn:
                  type: string
                dbEndpoint:
                  type: string
                dbPort:
                  type: integer
                roleArn:
                  type: string
                conditions:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      type:
                        type: string
                      status:
                        type: string
                      lastTransitionTime:
                        type: string
                        format: date-time
```

---

## 2. Composition (function-patch-and-transform)

```yaml
# apis/composition.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: app-infra-composition
  labels:
    environment: multi
    provider: aws
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: infra.example.com/v1alpha1
    kind: XAppInfra
  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:
    # ── Step 1: S3 Bucket ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    - step: s3-bucket
      functionRef:
        name: function-patch-and-transform
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        resources:
          # ── S3 Bucket ────────────────────────────────────────────
          - name: bucket
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Bucket
              metadata:
                labels:
                  crossplane.io/claim-name: ""
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: ""
                  tags:
                    ManagedBy: crossplane
                deletionPolicy: Orphan
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Environment
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.deletionPolicy
                toFieldPath: spec.deletionPolicy
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.bucketArn

          # ── Bucket Versioning ────────────────────────────────────
          - name: bucket-versioning
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketVersioning
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: ""
                  bucketRef:
                    name: ""
                  versioningConfiguration:
                    status: Enabled
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucketRef.name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

          # ── Bucket Encryption ────────────────────────────────────
          - name: bucket-encryption
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: ""
                  bucketRef:
                    name: ""
                  rule:
                    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                        - sseAlgorithm: AES256
                      bucketKeyEnabled: true
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucketRef.name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

          # ── Block Public Access ──────────────────────────────────
          - name: bucket-public-access-block
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: ""
                  bucketRef:
                    name: ""
                  blockPublicAcls: true
                  blockPublicPolicy: true
                  ignorePublicAcls: true
                  restrictPublicBuckets: true
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucketRef.name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

    # ── Step 2: S3 Replication (prod only) ─────────────────────────────
    - step: s3-replication
      functionRef:
        name: function-patch-and-transform
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        resources:
          # ── Replication IAM Role ─────────────────────────────────
          - name: replication-role
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Role
              metadata:
                name: ""
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  assumeRolePolicy: |
                    {
                      "Version": "2012-10-17",
                      "Statement": [
                        {
                          "Effect": "Allow",
                          "Principal": {
                            "Service": "s3.amazonaws.com"
                          },
                          "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
                        }
                      ]
                    }
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-replication-role"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Environment

          # ── Replication IAM Policy ───────────────────────────────
          - name: replication-policy
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: RolePolicy
              metadata:
                name: ""
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  roleRef:
                    name: ""
                  policy: ""
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-replication-policy"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.roleRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-replication-role"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: |
                        {
                          "Version": "2012-10-17",
                          "Statement": [
                            {
                              "Effect": "Allow",
                              "Action": [
                                "s3:GetReplicationConfiguration",
                                "s3:ListBucket"
                              ],
                              "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::%s"
                            },
                            {
                              "Effect": "Allow",
                              "Action": [
                                "s3:GetObjectVersionForReplication",
                                "s3:GetObjectVersionAcl",
                                "s3:GetObjectVersionTagging"
                              ],
                              "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::%s/*"
                            },
                            {
                              "Effect": "Allow",
                              "Action": [
                                "s3:ReplicateObject",
                                "s3:ReplicateDelete",
                                "s3:ReplicateTags"
                              ],
                              "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::%s-replica/*"
                            }
                          ]
                        }
                      type: Format
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Required

          # ── Replication Configuration ────────────────────────────
          - name: bucket-replication
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketReplicationConfiguration
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: ""
                  bucketRef:
                    name: ""
                  role: ""
                  rule:
                    - id: replicate-all
                      status: Enabled
                      destination:
                        - bucket: ""
                          storageClass: STANDARD
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucketRef.name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.role
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "arn:aws:iam::$(AWS_ACCOUNT_ID):role/%s-replication-role"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.rule[0].destination[0].bucket
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "arn:aws:s3:::%s-replica"

    # ── Step 3: RDS PostgreSQL ─────────────────────────────────────────
    - step: rds-postgresql
      functionRef:
        name: function-patch-and-transform
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        resources:
          # ── DB Subnet Group ──────────────────────────────────────
          - name: db-subnet-group
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: SubnetGroup
              metadata:
                name: ""
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: ""
                  description: "Subnet group for app database"
                  subnetIdSelector:
                    matchLabels:
                      role: private-data
                  tags:
                    ManagedBy: crossplane
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-db-subnet-group"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Environment

          # ── DB Security Group ────────────────────────────────────
          - name: db-security-group
            base:
              apiVersion: ec2.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: SecurityGroup
              metadata:
                name: ""
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: ""
                  description: "Security group for app database"
                  vpcIdSelector:
                    matchLabels:
                      role: main
                  ingress:
                    - fromPort: 5432
                      toPort: 5432
                      protocol: tcp
                      cidrBlocks:
                        - 10.0.0.0/8
                      description: "PostgreSQL from private subnets"
                  egress:
                    - fromPort: 0
                      toPort: 0
                      protocol: "-1"
                      cidrBlocks:
                        - 0.0.0.0/0
                      description: "Allow all outbound"
                  tags:
                    ManagedBy: crossplane
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-db-sg"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Environment

          # ── RDS Instance ─────────────────────────────────────────
          - name: db-instance
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Instance
              metadata:
                name: ""
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: ""
                  engine: postgres
                  engineVersion: "16.3"
                  instanceClass: db.t3.micro
                  allocatedStorage: 20
                  maxAllocatedStorage: 100
                  storageType: gp3
                  storageEncrypted: true
                  multiAZ: false
                  publiclyAccessible: false
                  deletionProtection: true
                  backupRetentionPeriod: 7
                  backupWindow: "03:00-04:00"
                  maintenanceWindow: "Mon:04:00-Mon:05:00"
                  skipFinalSnapshot: false
                  finalSnapshotIdentifier: ""
                  copyTagsToSnapshot: true
                  autoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
                  dbSubnetGroupNameRef:
                    name: ""
                  vpcSecurityGroupIdSelector:
                    matchLabels:
                      role: database
                  username: appadmin
                  passwordSecretRef:
                    namespace: crossplane-system
                    name: ""
                    key: password
                  tags:
                    ManagedBy: crossplane
                writeConnectionSecretToRef:
                  namespace: crossplane-system
                  name: ""
                deletionPolicy: Orphan
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-db"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.dbInstanceClass
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.dbMultiAZ
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAZ
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.dbAllocatedStorage
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.allocatedStorage
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbSubnetGroupNameRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-db-subnet-group"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-db-password"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.finalSnapshotIdentifier
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-final-snapshot"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.writeConnectionSecretToRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-db-connection"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Environment
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.deletionPolicy
                toFieldPath: spec.deletionPolicy
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.endpoint
                toFieldPath: status.dbEndpoint
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.port
                toFieldPath: status.dbPort
              # Prod: enforce backup retention >= 7
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.backupRetentionPeriod
                transforms:
                  - type: map
                    map:
                      dev: 7
                      prod: 30
              # Prod: skip final snapshot = false always
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.skipFinalSnapshot
                transforms:
                  - type: map
                    map:
                      dev: false
                      prod: false

    # ── Step 4: IAM Role for Service Account ───────────────────────────
    - step: iam-role
      functionRef:
        name: function-patch-and-transform
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        resources:
          # ── IAM Role (IRSA) ─────────────────────────────────────
          - name: service-account-role
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Role
              metadata:
                name: ""
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  assumeRolePolicy: ""
                  tags:
                    ManagedBy: crossplane
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-sa-role"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Environment
              # Dev: basic assume role; Prod: OIDC trust
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                combine:
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.oidcProviderArn
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.oidcProviderUrl
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccountNamespace
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccountName
                  strategy: string
                  string:
                    fmt: |
                      {
                        "Version": "2012-10-17",
                        "Statement": [
                          {
                            "Effect": "Allow",
                            "Principal": {
                              "Federated": "%s"
                            },
                            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                            "Condition": {
                              "StringEquals": {
                                "%s:sub": "system:serviceaccount:%s:%s",
                                "%s:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
                              }
                            }
                          }
                        ]
                      }
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.roleArn

          # ── S3 Access Policy (least privilege) ──────────────────
          - name: s3-access-policy
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: RolePolicy
              metadata:
                name: ""
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  roleRef:
                    name: ""
                  policy: ""
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-s3-access-policy"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.roleRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-sa-role"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: |
                        {
                          "Version": "2012-10-17",
                          "Statement": [
                            {
                              "Sid": "ListBucket",
                              "Effect": "Allow",
                              "Action": [
                                "s3:ListBucket",
                                "s3:GetBucketLocation",
                                "s3:GetBucketVersioning"
                              ],
                              "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::%s"
                            },
                            {
                              "Sid": "ObjectAccess",
                              "Effect": "Allow",
                              "Action": [
                                "s3:GetObject",
                                "s3:GetObjectVersion",
                                "s3:PutObject",
                                "s3:DeleteObject"
                              ],
                              "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::%s/*"
                            }
                          ]
                        }
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Required

          # ── RDS Access Policy (least privilege) ─────────────────
          - name: rds-access-policy
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: RolePolicy
              metadata:
                name: ""
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  roleRef:
                    name: ""
                  policy: ""
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-rds-access-policy"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.roleRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-sa-role"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: |
                        {
                          "Version": "2012-10-17",
                          "Statement": [
                            {
                              "Sid": "RDSConnect",
                              "Effect": "Allow",
                              "Action": [
                                "rds-db:connect"
                              ],
                              "Resource": "arn:aws:rds-db:*:*:dbuser:*/appadmin"
                            },
                            {
                              "Sid": "RDSDescribe",
                              "Effect": "Allow",
                              "Action": [
                                "rds:DescribeDBInstances",
                                "rds:DescribeDBClusters"
                              ],
                              "Resource": "*",
                              "Condition": {
                                "StringEquals": {
                                  "aws:RequestedRegion": ["us-east-1", "us-west-2"]
                                }
                              }
                            }
                          ]
                        }
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Required

    # ── Step 5: Connection Secret ──────────────────────────────────────
    - step: connection-secret
      functionRef:
        name: function-patch-and-transform
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        resources:
          - name: connection-details
            base:
              apiVersion: kubernetes.crossplane.io/v1alpha1
              kind: Object
              metadata:
                name: ""
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  manifest:
                    apiVersion: v1
                    kind: Secret
                    metadata:
                      name: ""
                      namespace: default
                    type: Opaque
                    stringData:
                      connection-string: ""
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: kubernetes-provider
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-connection-secret"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.manifest.metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-db-connection"
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                combine:
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: status.dbEndpoint
                    - fromFieldPath: status.dbPort
                  strategy: string
                  string:
                    fmt: "postgresql://appadmin:$(DB_PASSWORD)@%s:%d/appdb"
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.manifest.stringData.connection-string
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.forProvider.manifest.stringData.connection-string
                toFieldPath: status.dbConnectionString
```

## 3. Function Installation

```yaml
# functions/function-patch-and-transform.yaml
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: function-patch-and-transform
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/function-patch-and-transform:v0.7.0
```

## 4. Provider Configurations (Environment Isolation)

```yaml
# providers/provider-configs/dev.yaml
apiVersion: aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: ProviderConfig
metadata:
  name: aws-dev
spec:
  credentials:
    source: Secret
    secretRef:
      namespace: crossplane-system
      name: aws-creds-dev
```

## 7. Deployment Script

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# deploy.sh

set -euo pipefail

ENVIRONMENT=${1:-dev}

echo "Deploying Crossplane infrastructure for environment: $ENVIRONMENT"

# Install Crossplane (if not already installed)
if ! kubectl get namespace crossplane-system &>/dev/null; then
  echo "Installing Crossplane..."
  helm repo add crossplane-stable https://charts.crossplane.io/stable
  helm repo update
  helm install crossplane crossplane-stable/crossplane \
    --namespace crossplane-system \
    --create-namespace \
    --wait
fi

# Install providers
echo "Installing AWS providers..."
kubectl apply -f providers/provider-aws-s3.yaml
kubectl apply -f providers/provider-aws-rds.yaml
kubectl apply -f providers/provider-aws-iam.yaml

# Wait for providers to be healthy
echo "Waiting for providers to be healthy..."
kubectl wait --for=condition=Healthy provider.pkg.crossplane.io --all --timeout=300s

# Install function
echo "Installing function-patch-and-transform..."
kubectl apply -f functions/function-patch-and-transform.yaml

# Wait for function
kubectl wait --for=condition=Healthy function.pkg.crossplane.io/function-patch-and-transform --timeout=300s

# Apply provider configs
echo "Applying provider configs..."
kubectl apply -f providers/provider-configs/

# Decrypt and apply secrets
echo "Applying encrypted secrets..."
sops -d secrets/$ENVIRONMENT/db-credentials.sops.yaml | kubectl apply -f -

# Apply XRD
echo "Applying XRD..."
kubectl apply -f apis/xrd.yaml

# Wait for XRD to be established
kubectl wait --for=condition=Established xrd/xappinfras.infra.example.com --timeout=60s

# Apply Composition
echo "Applying Composition..."
kubectl apply -f apis/composition.yaml

# Apply Claim
echo "Applying Claim for $ENVIRONMENT..."
kubectl apply -f claims/$ENVIRONMENT/app-infra.yaml

echo "Deployment initiated. Monitor with:"
echo "  kubectl get appinfra -n $ENVIRONMENT"
echo "  kubectl get xappinfra"
echo "  kubectl get managed"
```

## Acceptance Criteria Mapping

| Criterion | Implementation |
|---|---|
| **Bucket: versioning + encryption + no public access** | `BucketVersioning` (Enabled), `BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration` (AES256), `BucketPublicAccessBlock` (all true) |
| **RDS: deletion protection + backup retention + not public** | `deletionProtection: true`, `backupRetentionPeriod: 7/30`, `publiclyAccessible: false` |
| **Secret: encrypted at rest** | SOPS-encrypted secrets in Git, decrypted at deploy time; Crossplane connection secrets in K8s |
| **IAM: least privilege, no wildcards on prod** | Specific S3/RDS actions only, resource-scoped ARNs, OIDC trust for prod |
| **Environment isolation** | Separate claims, provider configs, and SOPS-encrypted secrets per environment |
| **Prod requirements** | CEL validation rules enforce Multi-AZ, replication, and OIDC for prod |
